title: Choose a file
text: Drop it on the page or browse for it. Images, documents, spreadsheets, audio, video, archives, fonts and 3D models are all accepted.

title: Pick the format
text: The To list only ever shows formats that will genuinely work for your file, so there is nothing to guess.

title: Download
text: The result appears in a moment with a Download button, and a copy is kept in Your files in case you need it again.
